To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the critical behaviour of the investigated polymer mixture is in accordance with the 3d Ising model.
the light scattering data of the critical composition of the PEG/PPG mixture in the one- as well as in the two-phase regions are consistent with the Ising critical behaviour.

the critical behaviour of a mixture of polyethylene glycols and polypropylene is in accordance with the 3d Ising model, and that the critical composition is influenced by the formation of clusters of hydrogen bonds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of intermolecular hydrogen bonding on the critical behaviour of polymer blends.
the influence of hydrogen bond clusters in polymer blends and mixtures on the critical behaviour.
the influence of hydrogen bond clusters in polymer blends on the phase behaviour and critical fluctuations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

in a critical mixture of PEG and PPG the critical behaviour of the correlation length is governed by the 3d Ising universality class and the critical behaviour of diffusion is governed by mean field behaviour.
the critical composition fluctuations of the PPG600/PEG1000 blend are influenced by the formation of clusters of hydrogen bonded molecules.
the phase behaviour of the mixture of PEG600 and PPG1000 is determined by hydrogen bonds.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the phase behaviour of the PEG/PPG mixture can be explained by the formation of clusters caused by hydrogen bonding.
the critical behaviour of the PEG600/PPG1000 mixture is dominated by the influence of hydrogen bond clusters.
the influence of hydrogen bond clusters can be described by a pseudospinodal and that the critical behaviour of the critical mixture is in accordance with the 3d Ising model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hydrogen bond clusters can influence the critical behaviour of a polymer blend.
the critical behaviour of a mixture of PEG and PPG is dominated by the presence of hydrogen bond clusters.
the critical composition is not a pure composition but is influenced by the presence of clusters of the components.
